title: Parametric plate with mounting hole
task: Create a new Battenmark project named 'eval-basic-part'. Define parameters length=80, width=50, thickness=8, hole_d=5. Create a rectangular box using those parameters (min-corner origin). Add one through-hole of diameter hole_d on the top face, inset 10 mm from the min-corner edges. Validate the document, render a preview, and export an authoritative STEP (or FCStd) artifact. Units are millimetres.
